reviews.title: Log in fail
reviews.text:
Second time in a few months that the app log in fails repeatedly and I cannot use it. Updating the app does not help. I uninstalled and then reinstalled app and then could no longer use my old account. All possible emails and phone numbers were now some
How “not found” I hold out for a few weeks and then finally just make a new account forgoing the feature of colleagues because I don’t want to have to reconnect all of that but just to keep my schedule. But here we are again today, LOG In fAiLeD repeat repeat repeat! I’m over it

reviews.title: Unreliable lately
reviews.text: This app continues to crash and have trouble loading my calendar. It often says error or “login failure“ and requires a refresh, and then the refresh loads a completely empty calendar. Not good if it’s what you rely on solely for your work schedule.

reviews.title: Deleted after 5 minutes
reviews.text: Why in the world would an app designed for shifts make you input the times instead of creating presaved shifts and then choosing between those when throwing them in your schedule. I threw in my day shifts, changed the time and then put in my night shifts but apparently you have to save between every change in time. It felt like that moment you realized you didn’t save your Word doc after spending a long time on it. Not only that but you were deceived into thinking the Word doc was saving itself. Horrible design and no instructions.

reviews.title: Time to buy a planner again.
reviews.text: I’ve used this for a while now. I try to log in today and I see that the app is unavailable. I’m tired of not being able to see my schedule for multiple workplaces due to network issues and updates. I find it funny that an add was able to pop up still even though the functionality of the app is not there. I really don’t understand how your personal schedule isn’t available offline. If I have to upload to Apple or Google calendars then I may as well just use those apps natively. Sorry but y’all have lost it.

reviews.title: Mediocre at Best
reviews.text: You can't see your schedule if you don't have wifi or good service. i understand not being able to see other colleagues schedules but not even your own?? Also the interface is just old. Outdated. Too much detail to explain here what’s ancient technology in this app. Can't search by first name, can't switch shifts on your calender easily. Everything is multiple steps. Very frustrating not user friendly app. Would happily delete but the best function is being able to see co-workers schedules. That's it.

reviews.title: Helpful, but ads + questions suck
reviews.text:
This is really helpful for keeping me and my friends in the medical field in the know on each other’s schedules. 
But, buuuut, oh my god, you have to deal with so many stupid ads offering CEU’s (as though we don’t have that dialed in) and so many “Are you liking us?” “How ‘bout now…do you like us?” Our jobs are already irritating enough without this app stopping to take up more time clicking X on more “NO” boxes.
